text: Feature gates (flags) let you toggle product behavior live without redeploying code
quote: Feature Gates, commonly known as feature flags, allow you to toggle the behavior of your product in real time without deploying new code.

text: An emergency kill switch can immediately disable a code branch in production
quote: Have an emergency disable switch that lets you immediately turn off a particular code branch for users in production

text: Feature gates can be configured as scheduled rollouts to gradually deploy a feature over time
quote: Gradually deploy a feature over time by setting up a Feature Gate as a Scheduled Rollout.

text: Experimentation runs randomized controlled A/B or A/B/n trials to measure impact on key metrics
quote: Statsig experimentation runs randomized controlled trials (A/B or A/B/n tests) that measure how product changes affect your key metrics.

text: Scorecard lets you enter a hypothesis and pick primary/secondary metrics for an experiment
quote: The Scorecard feature makes this easy by letting you enter your hypothesis and select both primary and secondary metrics.

text: Autotune automatically shifts traffic toward the winning variant to maximize a target metric
quote: Unlike a standard A/B test, Autotune shifts traffic toward the winning variant to maximize a target metric.

text: Evaluation is deterministic — same user and experiment state always yield the same result across platforms
quote: Evaluation in Statsig is deterministic. Given the same user object and the same state of the experiment or feature gate, Statsig always returns the same result, even across different platforms (client or server).

text: On-Device Eval SDKs cache experiment/gate definitions on the client for faster local evaluation
quote: Statsig's client-side On-Device Eval SDKs provide an alternate client-side architecture. The device keeps the definition of each experiment or gate in memory, which allows faster evaluation when the user object changes frequently.

text: A CLI manages feature gates, experiments, and dynamic configs from the command line
quote: The Statsig CLI is a command-line interface that helps manage Feature Gates, Experiments, and Dynamic Configs within the Statsig platform.

text: An HTTP API lets you retrieve gate/experiment/config values and log events without an SDK
quote: Overview of the Statsig HTTP API for retrieving feature gate, experiment, and dynamic config values and logging events directly without an SDK.

text: A Console API provides full CRUD access equivalent to everything doable in the web console UI
quote: The Console API is the CRUD API for performing the actions available on console.statsig.com without using the web UI.

text: Supports SSO and SCIM together for enterprise identity management
quote: In many enterprise environments, organizations use SSO and SCIM together to improve security and usability.

text: An MCP server integrates Statsig data and actions into AI tools like Codex, Cursor, and Claude Code
quote: The Statsig MCP (Model Context Protocol) server brings the power of Statsig into tools like Codex, Cursor, and Claude Code. With this setup, you can ask questions, explore experiments, and access your Statsig data using AI.

text: A Docs MCP server lets AI clients read public Statsig documentation directly via an API endpoint
quote: Use the Statsig Docs MCP server to let supported AI clients read public Statsig documentation directly from /api/mcp.

text: Warehouse Native runs experimentation analysis directly inside your own data warehouse
quote: Statsig Warehouse Native is an experimentation platform that runs analysis directly in your data warehouse.

text: Offers advanced statistical methods including CUPED, Stratified Sampling, and Switchback Tests
quote: Statsig offers a full suite of experiment measurement tools, including CUPED, Stratified Sampling, Switchback Tests, and more.

text: Free tier includes feature flags plus 2 million metered events
quote: You get feature flags and 2 million metered events for free.

text: Infra Analytics ingests OpenTelemetry metrics/traces and sets alerts to catch regressions alongside product outcomes
quote: Infra Analytics: Monitor and debug service health alongside product outcomes. Ingest metrics and traces with OpenTelemetry, search and group logs, and set alerts to catch regressions.

text: Console lets you view feature gate exposures to see who encountered a live gate
quote: After your Feature Gate is live, view Feature Gate exposures in the Statsig console to monitor who encounters your gate.

text: Tutorial shows targeting a gate to mobile platforms and internal testers, then verifying it live via the JS SDK
quote: This tutorial creates a feature gate, targets mobile platforms and internal testers, then checks it live with the JavaScript SDK in your browser console.

text: Feature gate overrides let specific individual users bypass the gate
quote: set up Feature Gate overrides to allow specific users to bypass the gate.

text: A Layer lets you manage multiple experiments and feature flags together as a group
quote: A Layer allows you to manage multiple experiments and feature flags together.

text: The CLI can be integrated into CI/CD pipelines to automate flag and experiment management
quote: You can integrate the CLI into CI/CD pipelines to automate the management of Feature Gates and Experiments.

text: Supports auto-adding same-domain users and SSO to simplify inviting teams to a project
quote: Basic settings include automatically adding new users with the same email domain to your project. Statsig also supports SSO to simplify inviting your team to your projects.
